briefdescription.para: Computes the search parameters associated with detecting individuals in different life stages.

detaileddescription.para: These parameters influence interactions such as predation, competition, cannibalism, facilitation, and kin recognition, depending on the species’ ecology.

briefdescription.para: Methods related to detecting and interacting with individuals at different life stages.

detaileddescription.para: This group includes methods that compute search parameters or behavioral rules depending on the life stage of the individuals. It influences interactions such as predation, competition, cannibalism, facilitation, and kin recognition.
